**Pre-analysis note:** This article is dated **2026-08-21**, which is a future date. The content describes a scenario with Fed Chair **Kevin Warsh** (not Powell), a **war with Iran**, **30-year yields at 2007 highs**, and **Bitcoin at ~$77K-$79K** — this appears to be a speculative/synthetic future-scenario article. Analysis is based strictly on the content as written.

    rate hike, rising to 72% by December. The yen firmed on strong Japan CPI but
    remains fragile without BOJ tightening. Bitcoin surged as an alternative to fiat.
